visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens inside a hotel room, focusing on a wall-mounted television screen displaying a Japanese weather report. The map shows various regions of Japan with temperatures reaching 40 degrees Celsius. In the foreground, white rumpled bed linens are visible, suggesting a viewer's perspective from the bed. The lighting is soft and indoor. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor perspective at a traditional Japanese temple entrance with a large red building in the background. A crowd of people, some wearing traditional kimonos, walk towards the temple while holding umbrellas to shield themselves from the bright, direct natural sunlight. (3) The camera focuses on a retail display of umbrellas. A hand reaches in to flip a product tag, revealing technical text regarding UV protection levels. The background is filled with rows of black and navy umbrellas hanging on racks under bright store lighting. (4) The scene transitions to a supermarket shelf stocked with rows of blue Pocari Sweat bottles and salt-supplement products. A hand is seen holding a single bottle of Suntory water against the backdrop of a train station platform. (5) Close-up shots feature small portable electric fans and white neck cooling rings displayed on pegboard hooks in a store. The items are neatly organized for sale. (6) A series of news-style clips follow, showing the physical effects of extreme heat: a smartphone with a severely swollen battery on a wooden surface, a cracked glass window pane, and a black rubber tire being inspected. (7) The final sequence is a montage of outdoor scenery including a multi-story green and brown whimsical building, a row of colorful glass wind chimes hanging from a wooden frame, and a bronze sculpture of a cyclist perched on a large rock overlooking a calm lake with mountains in the distance.
